main_idea: Qwen3.5-9B's τ³-Banking pass@5 rose from 11.3% to 17.5% after training.
ideas: Training pipeline: teacher, hybrid OPD, PivotRL
summary: The 11.3% to 17.5% comparison is clear, but the sentence headline, slogan, pipeline cards, stats row and footer branding crowd it; nothing essential is missing.
defects: Stats row touches the bottom edge of the stage cards, with no gap.
Bars have no value labels and no shared axis, so the 11.3% and 17.5% marks are only loosely tied to them.
